hints.title: Adjacent Pair Elimination
hints.text: Whenever AB or CD appears consecutively, both characters are removed and adjacent letters fall together.

hints.title: Last In Matching
hints.text: Keep a list of retained characters. When the current character forms AB with the last character or CD with the last character, discard both.

hints.title: Final Length
hints.text: After processing all characters in s, the remaining list size is the answer.

hints.title: Stack Elimination Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string search and replace takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for retained characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models sequential substring cancellation using a stack in O(n) time.
